lessons.title: Tide Jumper: a runner where the button moves the sea
lessons.summary: A one-button runner where holding raises the sea instead of jumping, with a playable prototype and the tide mechanic in Lua.

lessons.title: Lighthouse Sweep: one beam, many ships, one button
lessons.summary: A one-button night-sea game where your lighthouse beam decides which ships can see, with a playable prototype and the steering in Lua.

lessons.title: Orbit Hopper: let go at the right moment
lessons.summary: A one-button space climber where you orbit a shrinking planet and press to fly off along the tangent, with a playable prototype and the orbit code in Lua.

lessons.title: Morse Garden: plant flowers with dots and dashes
lessons.summary: A one-button gardening game where short and long presses spell the seed you plant, with a playable prototype and the press reader in Lua.

lessons.title: Drawbridge Duty: one bridge, two queues, one button
lessons.summary: A one-button traffic game where holding raises a bridge for boats and releasing lowers it for carts, with a playable prototype and the bridge rules in Lua.

lessons.title: Kite in a Storm: reel in to climb, let go to escape
lessons.summary: A one-button storm game where holding reels a kite in and releasing lets line out, with a playable prototype and the kite physics in Lua.

lessons.title: Spinning Top Sumo: a duel where you only choose when
lessons.summary: A one-button duel where each top's aim arrow spins on its own and a press dashes that way, with a playable prototype and the dash and collision code in Lua.

lessons.title: Statue Garden: creep while the eyes are shut
lessons.summary: A one-button stealth game where you hold to creep and let go to freeze as a statue, with a playable prototype and the eye timers in Lua.

lessons.title: Hot Iron: hold to heat, let go to strike
lessons.summary: A one-button smithing game where holding heats the metal and letting go strikes it, with a playable prototype and the heat rules in Lua.

lessons.title: One-Switch Lift: run a building with a single lever
lessons.summary: A one-button management game where the lift drives itself and your only control flips its direction, with a playable prototype and the lift logic in Lua.

lessons.title: Magnet Marble: steer a ball you are not allowed to touch
lessons.summary: A physics puzzle where you guide a rolling marble only by flipping magnets between pull and push, with a playable prototype and the force code in Lua.

lessons.title: Sand Sorter: draw the walls, let the sand decide
lessons.summary: A falling sand puzzle where you draw and erase thin walls to route two colours of sand into their jars, with a playable prototype and the sand rule in Lua.

lessons.title: Gravity Postman: aim once, let the planets finish the route
lessons.summary: A slingshot delivery game where you choose only the direction and power of a letter and gravity bends the rest, with a prototype and Lua code.

lessons.title: Balloon Winds: steer by choosing your altitude
lessons.summary: A balloon game where you cannot steer and only rise or sink into wind layers, with a playable prototype and the balloon physics in Lua.

lessons.title: Rope Bridge in the Wind: build with something that only pulls
lessons.summary: A bridge building game where your only material is rope, which pulls but never pushes, with a playable prototype and the rope physics in Lua.

lessons.title: Spring Creature Workshop: build a body, then teach it to walk
lessons.summary: A sandbox where you build creatures from points, springs and pulsing muscles and race them, with a playable prototype and the muscle physics in Lua.

lessons.title: Water Wheel Workshop: light a village with water you never touch
lessons.summary: A calm physics toy where you arrange gutters so falling water spins a wheel and lights a village, with a playable prototype and the wheel code in Lua.

lessons.title: Paper Plane Wind Tunnel: tune the fold, then let go
lessons.summary: A tinkering game where you tune a paper plane's wing, nose weight and throw to land on targets, with a playable prototype and the flight code in Lua.
